### Reliability and operator diagnostics patch

`v0.2.1` tightens cache maintenance and makes failure recovery more precise.
Issue-comment parent repair now projects only the canonical records repaired by
the current bounded pass. The daemon serializes independent sync and RAG writers
per cache UUID while preserving coalescing and fair maintenance reconciliation.

Maintenance policy changes clear obsolete failure/backoff state and ignore
deselected collection frontiers. Admin validation identifies the invalid field,
lists blockers, and only renders a CLI handoff when one is available. Failed job
details now identify the failing collection and provide exact inspect and safe
remediation commands.

Release automation also uploads every compiled archive and `checksums.txt` to
the native GitCode Download section through the presigned attachment flow. The
GitHub Release remains a mirror and Markdown-link fallback; uploads are
idempotent by name and byte size and are verified by bounded readback.

GitCode review branches under `codex/**` now start the mirrored GitHub CI
workflow directly, without requiring a duplicate GitHub pull request or a
locally installed `gh` command.

There are no cache schema migrations or breaking CLI/MCP changes in this patch.
